items.heading: Name the Specific Path, Not
items.text: Name the specific path, not "something in skills." "I want to do a full-stack bootcamp and become a developer" lands differently than "I want to try tech stuff.".

items.heading: Bring the Real Cost
items.text: Bring the real cost and real timeline. Say the actual number and the actual 6-18 month runway before income starts, not an optimistic guess.

items.heading: Name Your Own Backup Plan
items.text: Name your own backup plan out loud. What happens if this path does not work in 12 months, a related degree still open, a different skill, or an exam track in parallel. Parents relax more when they see you have already thought about the downside.
